notes.text: In Shabbat the sages expressly release the vow of Rav Zutra son of Rav Zeira.
This witness expressly gives the son of Rav Zutra son of Rav Zeira. The additional generation stays visible.
The sources differ on which generation received the release. Nedarim has the additional son and Shabbat has Zutra himself.
